g.text: Armature AI Labs | actual CAD projections | dimensions in mm | A3 landscape

text.tspan: Sheet 1 of 2 | Frozen CAD section and exploded review | nominal hardware proposal

g.text: Prototype: hardware selection, tolerances, printed fit and loads unverified. Do not scale. Assembly publication remains pending source rights.
Bearing axis: X41, Z152.5; 50 mm neck span retained.
Carrier: OD12.4 around seat OD8.2; radial wall 2.1.
Blind fastener leaves 2.0 to the servo mating face.
Pin: precision OD3 land 8.5; M3 thread 3.9; total 14.2.
Spacers: ID3.1, OD4.2. Verify inner-race-only contact.
M3 nut: AF5.5 x 2.4 in AF5.7 x 2.5 side-load trap.
Retainer: 2.0; 2 x M2 x 8 and AF4 x 1.6 metal nuts.
Service with BodyFront removed; no shell carving.
Vendor, fits, thread/driver details and preload unverified.
